plain: NBC News reports an ongoing, sweeping tech outage at the US National Security Agency. Its sources say the cause was not a cyber one.

key_findings: NBC News describes a sweeping tech outage still ongoing at the NSA.
Unnamed sources told NBC News the disruption has not affected electronic intelligence-gathering and was not cyber-caused.
The cause has not been stated; the headline says some staff were told to work from home.
